title: The role of transport for socio-economic development
competency: Evaluate the role of transportation in economic and social development.

keywords.def: Transport with enough capacity that is reliable, so it brings economic and social benefits.

en.text: Efficient transport gives better access to markets, jobs and investment. Poor transport means missed opportunities and lower quality of life. Transport moves goods, spreads health care and education, and gives people mobility, especially in rural areas.

screens.title: A new road
screens.ask: A new road reaches a village near Jimma. What is the most likely change?
opts: Farmers can sell coffee in town markets more easily
screens.after: Roads give better access to markets. Farmers earn more and services arrive.

screens.title: 2.3.2 The role of transport for socio-economic development
paras: Efficient transport brings economic and social benefits.
Examples: better access to markets, employment and more investment.
Weak or unreliable transport has a cost: missed opportunities and lower quality of life.

screens.title: More roles
paras: Good transport moves goods within a country and abroad.
It spreads the benefits of health care and education.
Public transport gives people mobility, jobs, community resources and recreation.
screens.note: Focus: transport gives access to food, health care, education and jobs. It drives growth in rural areas.

screens.title: Key words
defs: Transport with enough capacity that is reliable, so it brings economic and social benefits.

screens.text: Which is a benefit of efficient transport?
opts: Better access to markets and jobs
screens.ans: Better access to markets and jobs
screens.why: The book lists markets, employment and investment.
screens.clue: Think of what a good road brings.

screens.text: Which are roles of transport, according to the book? Tap all.

screens.text: Unreliable transport can lower the quality of life.
screens.why: Deficient transport causes missed opportunities and lower quality of life.

screens.text: A health centre is 40 km from a village with no road. Which change would most improve health care there?
opts: Building a road and a bus service
screens.ans: Building a road and a bus service
screens.why: Transport spreads the benefits of health care: patients can reach the centre quickly.
screens.clue: What links people to the health centre?
